title: Melbourne 1956: Triumph and Drama in the Pool
grammar: Intensive aspectual verbs of endurance and triumph (végigküzd, helytáll, felülkerekedik)
goal: I can recount the dramatic 1956 Melbourne Olympics and the 'Blood in the Water' match against the Soviet Union.
I can use endurance and triumph verbs with preverbs (végigküzd, felülkerekedik, helytáll) under high psychological tension.
I can analyze how geopolitical trauma intersected with Olympic sportsmanship in December 1956.
